title: Galactic Language for Enchantments
description: All of the enchantments are in galactic language as they should be!
body:
All of the enchantments are now in galactic alphabet. Immersive :)

Resource pack works with ENG(US) and RUS languages.
Enchantments from [_Dungeons and Taverns_](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns), [_Katters Structures_](https://modrinth.com/datapack/katters-structures-only-dungeon) and [_Basic Weapons_](https://modrinth.com/mod/basicweapons) are supported as well!
